image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a complex multi-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (polished silver faces and black recessed areas). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The center cap displays a logo resembling the Mitsubishi three-diamond emblem. The wheel is resting on green grass, and part of the car's dark grey fender is visible at the top.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom center of the wheel, on the lower spokes/tire interface
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a distinct string of white characters that resembles text ('AUM...') but is nonsensical and malformed. This is a classic AI artifact where the model attempts to render branding or reflections as text but fails to produce legible letters.

The logo in the center cap mimics the Mitsubishi three-diamond shape but the geometry is warped and asymmetrical. The diamonds do not meet cleanly at the center, appearing slightly melted or misaligned.
The grass blades interacting with the tire contact patch appear slightly smudged and lack individual definition, blending into the tire rubber rather than being occluded by it sharply.
